The zero-thread result can become a durable config-level regression using the existing 21ef candidate/control pair. No substantive maintainer response, restored Arena-access trigger or other fresh upstream event is recorded. No external report is supported before the local regression, so maintenance does not displace it.
Reuse the admitted 21ef candidate/control bytes, pinned Nanoda source, exact mutation and historical comparison. No new theory or method is introduced, and the broader methods review remains current.

All scientific export inputs already exist locally. The selected successor must first implement and inert-test strict runner/accounting controls and commit exact zero-thread config/runtime bindings. Transfer still lacks a supplied independent package and CVC-4 remains historically gated.
